target.title: fix(chat.abort): pass stored sessionId to match active embedded runs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`chat.abort` does not reliably stop active embedded tool subprocesses, while `/stop` does. When an external client (e.g., Open WebUI) maps a UI stop button to `chat.abort`, the RPC returns `aborted: false` and the underlying tool subprocess keeps running.

Fixes #101162.

## Root Cause / Fix

**Root cause**: The `chat.abort` handler calls `abortChatRunsForSessionKeyWithPartials` without passing `sessionId`. The `/stop` path passes `entry?.sessionId`, which enables `resolveAuthorizedRunsForSessionKeys` to match active runs by session id in addition to session key (line 2454: `if (!sessionKeys.has(active.sessionKey) && !sessionIds.has(active.sessionId)) continue`).

**Fix**: Load the session entry via `loadSessionEntry(rawSessionKey, sessionLoadOptions)` and pass `entry?.sessionId` — the same pattern `/stop` already uses at line 3854.

## Evidence

### Code diff (3 lines, 1 file)

```diff
     if (!runId) {
+      const sessionLoadOptions = abortAgentId ? { agentId: abortAgentId } : undefined;
+      const { entry } = loadSessionEntry(rawSessionKey, sessionLoadOptions);
       const res = await abortChatRunsForSessionKeyWithPartials({
         ...
         agentId: abortAgentId,
+        sessionId: entry?.sessionId,
         defaultAgentId,
```

### /stop path reference (existing correct behavior)

The `/stop` path at line 3854 already passes `sessionId: entry?.sessionId`:
https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts#L3854

### Test Results

```
pnpm test src/gateway/server-methods/chat.abort-persistence.test.ts \
          src/gateway/server-methods/chat.abort-authorization.test.ts

 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  80 passed (80)
   Duration  70.81s
```

### Autoreview

```
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (1)
```

### oxfmt / oxlint / whitespace

- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts` — ✅
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts` — ✅
- `git diff --check` — ✅

## Change Type / Scope / Security Impact

- **Type**: fix
- **Scope**: Gateway `chat.abort` RPC handler
- **Files**: 1 file, +3 lines
- **Security**: No security impact
- **Backward compatibility**: Fully backward-compatible
